item.title: Gaza peace deal: Netanyahu hails hostage release plan, calls Trump; Hamas says states should ensure Israel implements ceasefire- Key points
item.description: A significant breakthrough in the Gaza conflict has been announced, with US President Donald Trump confirming Israel and Hamas have agreed to the first phase of his peace plan. This deal, brokered with the help of Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey, involves the release of all hostages and an Israeli troop withdrawal.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Derrick Groves arrested: Final escaped Louisiana inmate captured after 5 months; found hiding in ‘crawl space’
item.description: The final fugitive from a New Orleans jailbreak, Derrick Groves, convicted of double murder, has been apprehended in Atlanta after a nearly five-month manhunt. Groves was found hiding in a crawl space following a standoff. His capture concludes a significant breach of security, bringing relief to victims and the city.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘No idea’: Trump downplays Nobel peace prize chances; says ‘they'll find a reason not to give it to me’
item.description: Donald Trump is unsure about winning the Nobel Peace Prize. He stated his administration resolved seven wars and is close to settling an eighth. Trump believes he deserves the award for his peace efforts. The Nobel Peace Prize announcement is scheduled for Friday. Trump was previously nominated but did not win.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Very close’: Donald Trump says 'good chance' for Gaza peace deal; may visit Middle East by end of week
item.description: President Trump announced a Gaza peace deal with Hamas is 'very close,' potentially traveling to the Middle East Sunday. Negotiations, involving Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey, are based on a 20-point proposal for a ceasefire and Hamas disarmament. However, Hamas demands a full Israeli withdrawal and permanent ceasefire, seeking assurances against renewed military action.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Don’t want this on camera’: California gubernatorial hopeful Katie Porter storms out of interview; meltdown after Trump question
item.description: Gubernatorial hopeful Katie Porter faced backlash after abruptly ending an interview when questioned about winning over Trump supporters. Her reaction, captured on camera, drew criticism from Democrats and conservatives alike, raising concerns about her ability to address tough questions and connect with a broad electorate. Despite the controversy, Porter remains a leading candidate.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Jonathan Rinderknecht? Former Uber driver arrested for Palisades fire - All you need to know
item.description: A former Uber driver, Jonathan Rinderknecht, has been arrested in Florida and charged with maliciously starting the deadly Pacific Palisades fire. The blaze, which claimed 12 lives and caused extensive destruction, began shortly after midnight on New Year's Day. Investigators allege Rinderknecht was at the scene before the fire erupted.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: James Comey trial: Ex-FBI director pleads not guilty in court; calls it ‘vindictive, selective prosecution’
item.description: Former FBI Director James Comey pleaded not guilty to charges of making false statements and obstruction. The indictment followed President Trump's public calls for his prosecution. Comey's legal team plans to challenge the charges, citing vindictive and selective prosecution, and questioning the appointment of Trump's former lawyer as US Attorney. A trial is set for January 5.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pacific Palisades fire: Deadly LA inferno intentionally set? Florida man arrested, faces federal charges
item.description: A Florida man has been arrested for allegedly starting the devastating Pacific Palisades fire that claimed 12 lives and caused immense destruction. Investigators confirmed the blaze was intentionally set, leading to federal arson charges. This development opens the possibility of the death penalty for the suspect, as prosecutors weigh the severity of the crime.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Tried to have black man arrested’: Chicago mayor, Illinois governor fire back at Donald Trump; call it ‘full-blown authoritarianism’
item.description: Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson and Illinois Governor JB Pritzker have strongly condemned Donald Trump's calls for their jailing over alleged failures to protect ICE officers. Both Democrats accused Trump of authoritarianism and racial targeting, with Johnson stating he would not be intimidated. Pritzker highlighted Trump's deployment of federal forces and suggested a move towards authoritarianism.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Are you at fault if your cigarette ... ’: Man arrested over LA fire asked ChatGPT; generated AI image
item.description: A man accused of sparking a devastating Los Angeles wildfire allegedly consulted ChatGPT about his culpability after reporting the blaze. Investigators claim he set the initial fire, which later reignited, causing immense destruction. He reportedly lied to authorities and recorded videos of the inferno he is accused of starting.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump vs US states: President says Chicago mayor, Illinois governor ‘should be in jail’ - ICE row escalates
item.description: Former President Donald Trump called for the imprisonment of Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson and Illinois Governor JB Pritzker, accusing them of failing to protect federal immigration officers. This statement follows Johnson's executive order designating city property as an 'ICE Free Zone' and amid broader disputes over federal troop deployments in Democratic-led cities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 21 US lawmakers urge Donald Trump to 'repair and reset' ties with India
item.description: Twenty-one US lawmakers urged President Trump to reset ties with India, warning his punitive tariffs are harming both nations and pushing New Delhi towards rivals like China and Russia. The letter highlighted the strategic importance of India in the Indo-Pacific and the economic damage caused by the tariffs to American consumers and businesses.
item.dc:creator: Chidanand Rajghatta

item.title: 'Pushed India closer to China, Russia': US lawmakers write to Donald Trump over tariffs; urge him to restore ties
item.description: US lawmakers have urged President Trump to mend ties with India, warning that tariffs have pushed New Delhi closer to China and Russia. They highlighted the negative consequences for both nations, emphasizing India's crucial role in the Indo-Pacific and as a counterweight to China. The lawmakers stressed that tariffs harm American manufacturers and consumers, jeopardizing vital economic partnerships and innovation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Omar Yaghi? Meet first Saudi national to win Nobel Prize
item.description: Omar Yaghi, born in 1965 in Amman to a refugee family, rose from humble beginnings to become a world-renowned chemist and the first Saudi Nobel laureate in Chemistry. Renowned for pioneering reticular chemistry, his groundbreaking work on metal–organic frameworks addresses global challenges like water scarcity and carbon capture, earning him over 300 publications and international acclaim.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Indian national captured in Ukraine: Why citizens from dozens of countries are fighting in the Russia–Ukraine War
item.description: Ukrainian forces this week claimed to have detained 22-year-old Majoti Sahil Mohammed, an Indian citizen from Gujarat, who said he joined the Russian army after being promised freedom and good pay. His case mirrors those of several Indians who were duped by recruitment agents into enlisting as “helpers” or “security workers” in Russia, only to find themselves deployed on the frontlines. India has already confirmed that at least 27 of its citizens are serving with Russian units, and several have died in combat.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Air Arabia Abu Dhabi now flies direct to Damascus: Affordable flights, booking tips and travel hacks
item.description: Air Arabia Abu Dhabi is launching three weekly non-stop flights to Damascus starting October 28, 2025, making travel between the UAE and Syria significantly easier and more affordable. Fares are expected to range from AED 700-900 one-way, with early booking discounts available.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Britain's once-mighty Conservative Party is battling to avoid extinction
item.description: Britain's Conservatives, facing a significant decline in power and a challenge from the right-wing Reform UK, are adopting Donald Trump-style policies like mass deportations and budget cuts. Party leader Kemi Badenoch aims to win back voters by shifting the Tories rightward, emphasising fiscal prudence and stronger borders, though this risks alienating moderate members.

item.title: Where to buy gold this Diwali 2025 in Dubai: Top offers, free coins, raffles, and shopping hotspots you must know
item.description: Dubai’s Diwali 2025 shopping scene is packed with gold giveaways, festive discounts, and high-value raffles across jewellery stores, textile markets, and malls citywide. From winning up to AED150,000 in vouchers to scoring free gold coins and fashion deals, the Festival of Lights brings unbeatable offers. Participating outlets span Deira, Karama, Meena Bazaar, and major malls—check VisitDubai.com for full updates.

item.title: UAE to provide students with free Google Gemini Pro subscription for one year starting October 2025
item.description: University students in the UAE can now access Google Gemini Pro for free for one year, a cutting-edge AI platform designed to enhance learning and research. This initiative, part of the UAE's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, empowers students with advanced tools like Gemini 2.5 Pro and NotebookLM. Registration is open until December 9, 2025, requiring verification through SheerID.
